title: 学习与教育
desc: 覆盖终身学习、阅读、在线教育、能力培养、教育体制与师生关系的实用表达

entries.example: In an age of rapid change, lifelong learning has become a necessity rather than a luxury.
entries.exampleZh: 在迅速变化的时代，终身学习已成为必需而非奢侈。
entries.note: 不可数，作主语谓语用单数；常与 a culture of lifelong learning 连用，适合开头点题

entries.example: Only by updating our knowledge constantly can we keep pace with the times.
entries.exampleZh: 只有不断更新知识，我们才能与时俱进。
entries.note: 固定搭配 keep pace with；the times 必用复数，勿写成 the time，适合结尾段总结

entries.example: The internet has radically changed knowledge acquisition, making information available at a click.
entries.exampleZh: 互联网彻底改变了知识获取的方式，使信息一点即得。
entries.note: 书面名词短语，比 getting knowledge 正式；常作主语或介词宾语

entries.zh: 读写能力；（某领域的）素养
entries.example: Digital literacy has become as indispensable as the ability to read and write.
entries.exampleZh: 数字素养已变得像读写能力一样不可或缺。
entries.note: 不可数名词，可构成 digital/scientific/financial literacy；勿与 literature 混淆

entries.example: A genuine thirst for knowledge is what keeps a learner curious long after exams are over.
entries.exampleZh: 真正的求知欲，能使学习者在考试结束很久之后依然保持好奇。
entries.note: 固定搭配 thirst for sth；同义可用 a hunger for knowledge，作主语时用单数

entries.example: Studying abroad broadened her horizons in ways no textbook could have done.
entries.exampleZh: 海外求学以教科书无法做到的方式开阔了她的视野。
entries.note: horizons 必须用复数；也可说 expand one's horizons，用于读书、旅行、留学话题

entries.example: Reading classics allows us to converse with great minds across the centuries.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读经典让我们得以与跨越数世纪的伟大思想对话。
entries.note: classics 指经典作品时用复数；泛指阅读行为时以动名词短语 reading classics 作主语

entries.example: Deep reading sharpens our thinking, whereas skimming leaves us with mere fragments of information.
entries.exampleZh: 深度阅读磨砺我们的思维，而快速浏览只留给我们零碎的信息。
entries.note: 作主语时谓语用单数；常与 fragmented reading 对照使用，论证读书方法

entries.example: Fragmented reading may be convenient, but it rarely cultivates sustained concentration.
entries.exampleZh: 碎片化阅读也许方便，却很难培养持久的专注力。
entries.note: 用于分析手机阅读、短视频等现象；与 deep reading 并列构成对比论证

entries.zh: 博览群书的，学识渊博的
entries.example: Those who are well-read tend to express complex ideas with unusual clarity.
entries.exampleZh: 博览群书的人往往能以非凡的清晰度表达复杂的观点。
entries.note: 复合形容词，可作表语或定语；作定语时写成 a well-read person，勿写 well-reading

entries.zh: 有启发性的，令人豁然开朗的
entries.example: The lecture was so enlightening that it changed the way I viewed my own major.
entries.exampleZh: 那场讲座极具启发性，以至于改变了我对自己专业的看法。
entries.note: 多修饰 book/lecture/experience；与 enlightened（开明的）区分，勿混用

entries.example: Online learning offers remarkable flexibility, but it also demands far greater self-discipline.
entries.exampleZh: 在线学习提供了极大的灵活性，但也要求更强的自律。
entries.note: 不可数，作主语用单数谓语；同义表达 e-learning，可与课堂教学对比论证

entries.zh: 大型开放式网络课程（Massive Open Online Course）
entries.example: MOOCs have made courses from top universities accessible to learners worldwide.
entries.exampleZh: 慕课使世界各地的学习者都能获取顶尖大学的课程。
entries.note: 首现时宜写出全称；复数 MOOCs，作主语谓语用复数，勿大小写混排

entries.example: Without government support, the digital divide may widen the gap in educational opportunity.
entries.exampleZh: 若无政府支持，数字鸿沟可能扩大教育机会上的差距。
entries.note: 固定搭配，常与 bridge/narrow/widen 连用；适合讨论在线教育公平性的主体段

entries.example: Autonomous learning places the responsibility for progress squarely on the learner's own shoulders.
entries.exampleZh: 自主学习把进步的完全责任放在学习者自己肩上。
entries.note: 不可数名词短语，常与 cultivate/foster 搭配；比 self-study 更书面

entries.example: Critical thinking enables students to question what they read rather than accept it blindly.
entries.exampleZh: 批判性思维使学生能够质疑所读内容，而不是盲目接受。
entries.note: 常搭配 develop/cultivate critical thinking；critical 此处意为审慎评判的，非批评的

entries.example: Internships give students the hands-on ability that classroom lectures can never provide.
entries.exampleZh: 实习赋予学生课堂讲授永远无法提供的动手能力。
entries.note: hands-on 为复合形容词；同义可说 practical ability，中国考生使用判分友好

entries.example: Schools should attach equal importance to academic excellence and all-round development.
entries.exampleZh: 学校应同等重视学业优秀与全面发展。
entries.note: 英式写法 all-round，美式常用 well-rounded；常搭配 promote/facilitate

entries.zh: 全面发展的，多才多艺的
entries.example: Universities aim to produce well-rounded graduates rather than narrow specialists.
entries.exampleZh: 大学旨在培养全面发展的毕业生，而非狭隘的专才。
entries.note: 作定语修饰 person/graduate/education；与 narrow specialist 对比使用效果最佳

entries.example: Exam-oriented education often trains students to memorize rather than to think.
entries.exampleZh: 应试教育往往训练学生记忆，而非思考。
entries.note: 亦作 test-oriented；与 quality-oriented education 成对出现，构成对比论证

entries.example: Shifting from exam-oriented to quality-oriented education requires more than a change of policy.
entries.exampleZh: 从应试教育转向素质教育，需要的不只是一纸政策的改变。
entries.note: 中国语境特有表达，首现后可用 it 指代；quality 前不加定冠词

entries.example: Making nine-year compulsory education genuinely free has eased the burden on rural families.
entries.exampleZh: 让九年义务教育真正免费，减轻了农村家庭的负担。
entries.note: compulsory 意为强制的、义务的；常与 nine-year、free 连用修饰 schools 或 system

entries.example: Vocational training equips school leavers with skills that the job market urgently needs.
entries.exampleZh: 职业培训使离校者掌握就业市场迫切需要的技能。
entries.note: 不可数；与 academic education 相对，讨论就业与教育结构时常并提

entries.example: Rote learning may raise test scores, but it seldom produces genuine understanding.
entries.exampleZh: 死记硬背或许能提高考试成绩，却很少产生真正的理解。
entries.note: 不可数名词，含贬义；动词短语形式为 learn by rote，两者勿混用

entries.example: Millions of graduates sit the postgraduate entrance examination each year in search of better prospects.
entries.exampleZh: 每年有数百万毕业生参加研究生入学考试，以求更好的发展前景。
entries.note: 动词用 take/sit the exam；首现写全称，后文可用 the exam 或 it 指代

entries.zh: 继续深造，攻读更高学历
entries.example: Some graduates choose to pursue further education abroad to gain an international perspective.
entries.exampleZh: 一些毕业生选择出国深造，以获得国际化的视野。
entries.note: pursue 后接名词；也可说 pursue a master's degree，degree 前须加 a

entries.example: A student's academic performance depends on far more than the hours spent in the library.
entries.exampleZh: 一个学生的学习成绩，取决于远不止在图书馆里待的时长。
entries.note: 不可数；常搭配 improve/poor academic performance，图表作文描述数据时常用

entries.example: Excessive academic pressure can undermine the very curiosity that education is meant to inspire.
entries.exampleZh: 过度的学业压力会损害教育本应激发的求知欲。
entries.note: 常搭配 under great academic pressure、relieve pressure on students；心理话题必备

entries.zh: 学历证书，资格证明；资历
entries.example: Employers increasingly value practical skills over paper credentials alone.
entries.exampleZh: 雇主日益看重实际技能，而不仅是纸质文凭。
entries.note: 常用复数 credentials；比 diploma 更强调资历证明，适合学历与能力之争的话题

entries.zh: 奖学金；（另一义）学术研究
entries.example: She won a full scholarship that covered both her tuition and living expenses.
entries.exampleZh: 她获得了一份全额奖学金，涵盖学费和生活费。
entries.note: 可数名词，搭配 win/obtain/award a scholarship；另一义为学术研究，须看语境

entries.example: Rising tuition fees have forced many families to reconsider their children's choices.
entries.exampleZh: 不断上涨的学费迫使许多家庭重新考虑孩子的选择。
entries.note: 不可数名词；英式常说 tuition fees，pay one's tuition 意为付学费

entries.example: A good mentor does not simply pass on knowledge but shows students how to learn.
entries.exampleZh: 好的导师不只是传授知识，而是教会学生如何学习。
entries.note: 可数名词，也可作动词意为指导；常搭配 act as a mentor to sb，比 teacher 更有敬意

entries.zh: 逐渐灌输（思想、品质、习惯）
entries.example: Parents should instill in their children a respect for honesty and hard work.
entries.exampleZh: 父母应向孩子灌输对诚实与勤勉的尊重。
entries.note: 搭配 instill sth in/into sb，宾语位置勿放错；英式亦可拼作 instil，全文须统一

entries.example: Schools should nurture curiosity rather than suppress it with endless examinations.
entries.exampleZh: 学校应培育好奇心，而不是用无尽的考试压制它。
entries.note: 及物动词，宾语多为 talent/curiosity/creativity；与 rather than suppress 对照更有力

entries.zh: 培养，促进（某种能力或风气）
entries.example: Group projects foster cooperation and teach students to value different perspectives.
entries.exampleZh: 小组项目培养合作精神，并教学生珍视不同的视角。
entries.note: 及物动词，搭配 foster creativity/independence/cooperation；比 develop 更显高级

entries.zh: 培养，陶冶（习惯、兴趣、能力）
entries.example: Reading widely helps students cultivate the habit of thinking independently.
entries.exampleZh: 广泛阅读有助于学生培养独立思考的习惯。
entries.note: 宾语多为 habit/interest/ability；与 foster 可互换，但更强调长期养成

entries.example: A single question from a teacher may enlighten a student more than a whole lecture.
entries.exampleZh: 老师的一个问题，也许比一整堂课更能启发学生。
entries.note: 宾语通常为人，可用 enlighten sb on sth；派生词 enlightenment、enlightening 勿混用

entries.example: Teachers who read widely inevitably set an example for their students.
entries.exampleZh: 广泛阅读的教师无形中为学生树立了榜样。
entries.note: 常接 for/to sb；褒义用 set a good example，反面说法是 set a bad example

entries.example: Knowledge becomes truly useful only when we put theory into practice.
entries.exampleZh: 只有当我们把理论付诸实践，知识才真正有用。
entries.note: 也可说 put sth into practice 替换中间宾语；论述实习与实践教学的核心句

entries.example: Internship programmes integrate classroom learning with real workplace experience.
entries.exampleZh: 实习项目把课堂学习与真实的职场经验结合起来。
entries.note: A、B 处替换具体对象；注意 integrate A into B 意为把 A 融入 B，介词不可混用

entries.zh: 学以致用，把所学应用于实践
entries.example: Graduates who can apply what they have learned to new situations adapt fastest.
entries.exampleZh: 能把所学应用于新情境的毕业生适应得最快。
entries.note: what 引导宾语从句，人称随主语变化；用于论述实践能力与就业竞争力的段落

entries.en: As is vividly depicted in the picture, ___.
entries.zh: 正如图画所生动描绘的，___。（图画作文首段万能句式）
entries.example: As is vividly depicted in the picture, a father and his son are reading side by side.
entries.exampleZh: 正如图画所生动描绘的，一位父亲和他的儿子正并肩阅读。
entries.note: as 指代整个主句内容，勿改成 It is vividly depicted that；首段描述图画直接套用

entries.en: It is widely acknowledged that ___ plays an indispensable role in ___.
entries.zh: 人们普遍认为，___在___中起着不可或缺的作用。
entries.example: It is widely acknowledged that reading plays an indispensable role in shaping one's character.
entries.exampleZh: 人们普遍认为，阅读在塑造人的品格中起着不可或缺的作用。
entries.note: 形式主语句；indispensable 后接 to 或 in 均可，主体段首句引入话题极稳妥

entries.en: Not only does ___, but it also ___.
entries.zh: ___不仅___，而且还___。（not only 置于句首引起部分倒装）
entries.example: Not only does online learning save time, but it also makes quality courses accessible to all.
entries.exampleZh: 在线学习不仅节省时间，还使优质课程人人可及。
entries.note: not only 后必须倒装，but also 后恢复陈述语序；用于列举双重好处

entries.en: Nothing is more conducive to ___ than ___.
entries.zh: 没有什么比___更有利于___。（比较级表最高级，强调最佳途径）
entries.example: Nothing is more conducive to genuine learning than an active and curious mind.
entries.exampleZh: 没有什么比一颗主动而好奇的心更有利于真正的学习。
entries.note: conducive 后固定接 to，不能用 for；句式简短有力，适合置于段落结尾

entries.en: What matters is not ___, but whether ___.
entries.example: What matters is not how much we read, but whether we read thoughtfully.
entries.exampleZh: 重要的不是我们读了多少，而是我们是否带着思考去读。
entries.note: what 引导主语从句，后接 whether 表语从句；论述辩证观点时非常好用

entries.example: Only when knowledge is applied to real problems can we call it true learning.
entries.exampleZh: 只有当知识被用于解决真实问题时，我们才能称之为真正的学习。
entries.note: only 加状语从句置于句首，主句倒装；与 Only by doing 结构区分，后者接动名词

entries.en: It is high time that we ___.
entries.zh: 该是我们___的时候了。（that 从句用过去式或 should 加动词原形的虚拟语气）
entries.example: It is high time that we attached greater importance to quality-oriented education.
entries.exampleZh: 该是我们更加重视素质教育的时候了。
entries.note: that 从句谓语用过去式或 should do；结尾段提出呼吁，语气强于 we should

entries.example: Live and learn, for the knowledge that served us yesterday may be obsolete tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 活到老学到老，因为昨天管用的知识明天可能就已过时。
entries.note: 用于终身学习主题的结尾；两个动词均为原形，勿改成 Living and learning

entries.zh: 知识就是力量。（常归于弗朗西斯·培根）
entries.example: Knowledge is power, but only when it is translated into action.
entries.exampleZh: 知识就是力量，但唯有在它转化为行动之时才如此。
entries.note: 引用时可就出处写 Francis Bacon；后接 but 转折更显思辨，适合开头或结尾

entries.zh: 读书使人充实。（弗朗西斯·培根《论读书》）
entries.example: As Bacon observed, reading makes a full man, whereas discussion makes a ready one.
entries.exampleZh: 正如培根所言，读书使人充实，而讨论使人机敏。
entries.note: 出自《论读书》，原句与讨论、写作三者并列；适合阅读主题的开头段

entries.en: It is never too late to learn.
entries.example: It is never too late to learn, as the growing number of elderly college students suggests.
entries.exampleZh: 学习永远不嫌晚，老年大学生人数不断增加便说明了这一点。
entries.note: 用于终身学习、老年教育话题；形式主语 it 不可换成 you are，后者过于口语

entries.example: Practice makes perfect, which is why repeated drills still matter in skill training.
entries.exampleZh: 熟能生巧，这就是为什么反复练习在技能训练中仍然重要。
entries.note: 用于论述实践与技能训练；后可接 which 定语从句或 that is why 结构

entries.en: There is no royal road to learning.
entries.zh: 学无坦途。（相传出自欧几里得对国王的回答）
entries.example: There is no royal road to learning, so short cuts are seldom worth taking.
entries.exampleZh: 学无坦途，因此所谓的捷径往往不值得走。
entries.note: royal road 意为捷径而非御道；可用于劝学与坚持主题的论证句

entries.en: A little learning is a dangerous thing.
entries.zh: 一知半解最危险。（亚历山大·蒲柏《论批评》）
entries.example: A little learning is a dangerous thing, which is why superficial knowledge breeds false confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 一知半解最危险，这正是肤浅的知识滋长盲目自信的原因。
entries.note: 出自蒲柏《论批评》；用于批评浮躁学风，注意 learning 前有 a，不可省略
